repositoryId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.repositoryId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Repository that owns this binding, when the owner is a repository rather than an agent version, workflow version, skill version, or automation version; exactly one owner reference must be set.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

agentVersionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.agentVersionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Immutable agent version that owns this binding, when the owner is that agent rather than a repository, workflow, skill, or automation version.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

workflowVersionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.workflowVersionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Immutable workflow version that owns this binding; required whenever stepKey is set, since a step-scoped binding always belongs to a workflow version.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

skillVersionOwnerId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.skillVersionOwnerId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Skill version that owns this binding, when the skill itself rather than a repository, agent, workflow, or automation version is being granted the target.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

automationVersionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.automationVersionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Automation version that owns this binding, when a scheduled automation rather than a repository, agent, workflow, or skill holds the grant.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

stepKey.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.stepKey may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.stepKey must contain at most 200 characters.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

mcpConnectionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.mcpConnectionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: MCP connection this binding grants access to, when the target is an MCP server rather than an integration connection or skill version; exactly one target reference must be set.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

integrationConnectionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.integrationConnectionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Integration connection this binding grants access to, when the target is a provider connection rather than an MCP connection or skill version.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

skillVersionId.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.skillVersionId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Skill version this binding grants access to, when the target is a specific skill rather than an MCP connection or integration connection.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

items.description: Provider or MCP operation names this binding permits its owner to invoke on the target; operations outside this list remain denied even if the target supports them. Each array item follows this format.

allowedOperations.description: CapabilityBindingCreate.allowedOperations must contain at most 100 items.

required.description: Whether the owner's execution must fail rather than silently proceed when this binding's target is unavailable or its grant is revoked, distinguishing a required capability from an optional one.

CapabilityBindingCreate.description: Creates one immutable capability binding tying exactly one owner (repository, agent version, workflow version, skill version, or automation version) to exactly one target (MCP connection, integration connection, or skill version) with a fixed set of allowed operations.

provider.description: Chat provider that owns the channel being linked; only "slack" is supported today, with providers such as Discord or Microsoft Teams planned as later adapters.

channelId.description: ChannelLinkCreate.channelId must contain at most 200 characters.

mode.description: Selects whether the linked channel behaves as a full two-way conversation, accepting mentions and thread replies as chat turns, or as a notifications-only channel that receives progress messages until a linked human identity is configured.

ChannelLinkCreate.description: Binds an external Slack channel or thread to this conversation, creating the routing Bakery uses to post messages to it and accept messages from it.

ArtifactExtractQuery.description: Optional bounded UTF-8 extraction window for an authorized safe-text artifact version.

range.description: ContentRangeQuery.range must contain at most 100 UTF-8 bytes.

ContentRangeQuery.description: Requests a byte range of an artifact version's content via a standard HTTP Range read.

applicationId.description: ConversationCreate.applicationId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Application this conversation belongs to; omit or set null for an organization-wide conversation not scoped to any single application.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

repositoryId.description: ConversationCreate.repositoryId may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Repository this conversation belongs to; it must belong to the given application. Omit or set null for an installation-wide conversation, which requires installation-level access rather than falling back from a denied repository.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

title.description: ConversationCreate.title must contain at most 300 characters.

ConversationCreate.description: Starts a new conversation with an immutable access boundary: a repository conversation inherits that repository's application, while omitting repository/application creates an application-only or fully organization-wide conversation. Creating a conversation does not itself create a task.

title.description: ConversationUpdate.title must contain at most 300 characters.

archivedAt.description: ConversationUpdate.archivedAt may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: Marks the conversation archived (non-null) or active again (null); archived conversations reject new messages.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

ConversationUpdate.description: Edits a conversation's title or archived state; its scope (application/repository) cannot be changed here because that boundary is immutable after creation.

cursor.description: CursorQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

CursorQuery.description: Generic keyset-pagination input reused by every plain list operation (applications, repositories, tasks, runs, workflows, agents, skills, and more); rejects page/offset-style parameters and binds its cursor to the specific operation, principal, and scope that issued it.

name.description: DefinitionUpdate.name must contain at most 200 characters.

description.description: DefinitionUpdate.description may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: DefinitionUpdate.description must contain at most 2000 characters.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

enabled.description: Whether this workflow, agent, or skill is available for new use. For a workflow, disabling it blocks new kickoff while any run already in progress continues under the existing cancellation policy.

DefinitionUpdate.description: Partial update to a named definition's (workflow, agent, or skill) display name, description, and enabled state; does not touch its slug or version history.

id.description: Identifier of the task that owns the dependency link being removed; this is the `{id}` path segment, not the dependency record itself.

dependencyId.description: Identifier of the task_dependencies record to delete; this is the dependency edge's own id, distinct from either task it connects.

DependencyPath.description: Path identifying one task-dependency edge to remove, addressed by its owning task and its own dependency record id.

repositoryId.description: Repository whose release is being deployed.

runId.description: Workflow run whose merge produced the commit and artifact being deployed, tying this deployment back to its originating evidence.

environment.description: Target for this release: preview for an ephemeral review environment, staging for pre-production validation, or production for live traffic. Deployments to the same environment are serialized.

commitSha.description: Commit SHA of the merged revision being deployed; must match the commit the merge step produced for this repository.

artifactDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the built release artifact being deployed, verified against the stored artifact before the delivery adapter runs prepare.

DeploymentCreate.description: Registers a release for deployment to one environment; deployments to the same environment are serialized and only a merged, tested revision is accepted.

reason.description: DeploymentRollback.reason must contain at most 2000 characters.

DeploymentRollback.description: Requests reverting an environment to its previous deployment; the adapter issues a new stable effect key and the restored commit becomes the new current release.

Empty.description: Empty request body reused by operations that need no input beyond their route parameters and authorization, such as a connection health check or MCP capability discovery.

EmptyInput.description: Empty workflow action input for actions that take no parameters, such as workflow.noop; any property is rejected.

repositoryId.description: Repository this case's fixtures and expected behavior are scoped to.

name.description: EvaluationCaseCreate.name must contain at most 200 characters.

inputArtifactVersionId.description: Artifact version supplying this case's typed input to the evaluated target.

expected.description: EvaluationCaseCreate.expected must contain at most 32000 UTF-8 bytes.

tags.description: EvaluationCaseCreate.tags must contain at most 50 items.

items.description: Free-form labels for filtering and grouping this case within its dataset's case list; they do not affect scoring. Each array item follows this format.

EvaluationCaseCreate.description: Adds one test case to an evaluation dataset; saving it creates a new immutable dataset revision rather than mutating results already scored against the prior one.

items.description: JSON value node.

slug.description: EvaluationDefinitionCreate.slug must contain at most 100 characters.

revision.description: EvaluationDefinitionCreate.revision must be at least 1.

evaluatorType.description: Selects the scoring mechanism: deterministic runs a registered code check with an exact pass/fail reason, model runs a configured rubric-judgment scorer that produces a score and rationale.

config.description: EvaluationDefinitionCreate.config must contain at most 32000 UTF-8 bytes.

Overrides under `config.repositoryRules` are validated against the latest organization rules and rejected with UNPROCESSABLE naming every locked rule they replace or disable, and with UNPROCESSABLE `repository_rules_too_large` when they could never fit the repository inspection budget. A publication that states a `repositoryRules` key (even empty) or replaces an active profile carrying overrides also requires the repository `If-Match` version, activates itself like a `fixedPolicy` publication, and supersedes the inspection evidence of a replaced observed profile until onboarding is run again. Any publication that auto-activates over an existing active profile (fixed policy, rules key, restore, or default-branch mismatch; not the first profile) also requires `repository:manage` like PATCH activation, checked before the If-Match comparisons; a rules-caused activation, over any active profile the workflow, branches, worktree, agent bindings and fixed policy must be retained or the request is refused with UNPROCESSABLE `repository_rules_must_retain_config`. approvalId.description: Approval that authorizes this run when the task's stage policy requires human approval of the plan. It is consumed once, inside the admission transaction, only when it is approved, unexpired, unrevoked and bound to this task, the current approved plan revision digest, the plan stage and the task's policy digest; otherwise admission fails with STATE_CONFLICT approval_unavailable and creates no run.

RunCreate.description: Starts a new run of a task using a pinned workflow version and, for repository-mode execution, a pinned repository profile. Repository-mode admission also resolves the latest organization rules against that profile once and freezes organization revision, profile identity, effective entries with provenance and the canonical digest into the immutable run snapshot; every job of the run carries that pin, a later organization or profile publication never changes it, and stored rules that cannot be read fail admission with STATE_CONFLICT repository_rules_unavailable. The run's own workflow steps are checked against the pinned `require` rules like a publication: a workflow that changes a repository revision (`harness.implement` or `harness.repair`) without a later `quality.check` stage that lists a bound command is refused with UNPROCESSABLE `repository_rule_stage_missing` or `repository_rule_stage_before_revision` naming the rule key, which includes the built-in fixed-coding preset and any version published or activated before the rule existed; a pin that cannot fit the job input is refused with UNPROCESSABLE `repository_rules_too_large` at `repositoryRules`. A workflow with the review and repair loop shape (the fixed-coding-reviewed preset) is also refused with UNPROCESSABLE `profile_effect_denied` at `repositoryProfileId` when the pinned profile has no observed fixed policy with a command or does not allow the effects of its steps, so a mis-set profile fails before the implement step spends, and its snapshot freezes the loop bounds (maxRepairCycles, maxLoopDurationMs, maxFindings). No run or task change is written on a refusal.

digest.description: Optional check against the server-computed canonical digest of `definition`; a supplied value that differs fails with UNPROCESSABLE digest_mismatch.

sourceYaml.description: WorkflowVersionCreate.sourceYaml must contain at most 100000 characters.

WorkflowVersionCreate.description: Creates the definition's single shared mutable draft; publication is the separate publish action.

items.description: JSON value node.

id.description: Identifier of the workflow definition that owns the version; this is the `{id}` path segment.

versionId.description: Identifier of the draft or published workflow version within that definition; this is the `{versionId}` path segment.

WorkflowVersionPath.description: Path identifying one workflow version, addressed by its owning workflow definition and its own version id.

definition.description: WorkflowDraftUpdate.definition must contain at most 100000 UTF-8 bytes.

sourceYaml.description: WorkflowDraftUpdate.sourceYaml must contain at most 100000 characters.

WorkflowDraftUpdate.description: Replaces the content of the definition's shared draft under the draft's optimistic-concurrency version; published versions are immutable and cannot be updated.

items.description: JSON value node.

expectedDigest.description: Optional check that the draft still has this canonical digest; a mismatch fails with STATE_CONFLICT validation_stale and publishes nothing.

WorkflowVersionPublish.description: Publishes the draft as an immutable workflow version after full validation; callers send an empty JSON object when no digest check is wanted. An enabled `require` rule of the latest organization rules bound to a fixed policy command needs a `quality.check` stage that lists that command literally and runs after the last stage that changes the repository revision; a draft without it is refused with UNPROCESSABLE `repository_rule_stage_missing` or `repository_rule_stage_before_revision` naming the rule key, and nothing is written. Only workflows with a stage that changes a repository revision are bound, and a check stage with an `if` condition does not count because it may be skipped.

versionId.description: Published workflow version of this definition to make the active version that a workflowId run start pins.

WorkflowActivationCreate.description: Activates one published version of a workflow definition under the definition's optimistic-concurrency version. The version is re-checked against the latest organization rules like a publication, so a version published before a `require` rule existed is refused with the same typed UNPROCESSABLE issue and the active version stays unchanged.

id.description: Skill version to read the manifest and metadata for; supplied via the request's {id} path segment.

attemptId.description: Worker attempt ID carried in the X-Bakery-Attempt-Id header when a worker rather than a human is reading this version; required with leaseToken and fence to prove the attempt holds a live lease with this exact version pinned in its job.

leaseToken.description: Bearer lease token carried in the X-Bakery-Lease-Token header, proving the requesting worker attempt currently holds its job's lease; required for a worker read and never logged.

fence.description: Current fence value carried in the X-Bakery-Fence header for the requesting worker's attempt; a stale or mismatched fence rejects the read as belonging to a superseded attempt.

SkillVersionPath.description: Path and worker-lease parameters for reading one skill version's manifest and metadata; a human caller needs catalog/repository read authority, while a worker caller must additionally prove its live lease, attempt and fence for the exact version pinned to its job.

path.description: SkillFileUpload.path must contain at most 500 characters.

mediaType.description: MIME media type of this file's content, recorded alongside it so a worker or viewer knows how to interpret the decoded bytes.

isExecutable.description: Whether this file's executable bit should be set when materialized on a worker's filesystem, preserving script intent for entry points and helper scripts; ordinary text and template files leave this false.

contentBase64.description: This file's complete bytes, base64-encoded; the server strictly decodes and hashes it, and decoded content across every file in the version is capped at 10MiB.

SkillFileUpload.description: One file entry within a LocalSkillVersion upload: its relative path, media type, executable bit and base64-encoded content; paths must be unique after NFC normalization and case folding, and decoded content across the version is capped at 10MiB.

commentId.description: Identifier of the root comment being referenced.

CommentReference.description: Names one existing root comment and the version it must currently be at, used to select feedback for a compare-and-swap operation such as sending comments to the agent.

blockIndex.description: Zero-based block index containing the markdown anchor.

selectedText.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.selectedText must contain at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

start.description: Character offset where the markdown selection begins.

end.description: Character offset where the markdown selection ends.

blockText.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.blockText must contain at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

anyOf.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.previousBlock must contain at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

previousBlock.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.previousBlock may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.nextBlock must contain at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

nextBlock.description: CommentAnchor.markdown.nextBlock may be null in this transport value.

startLine.description: One-based source line where the text anchor begins.

endLine.description: One-based source line where the text anchor ends.

quote.description: CommentAnchor.text.quote must contain at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file this patch-anchored comment targets, within the diff bounded by baseSha and headSha. The server revalidates that the path, side, and line range actually exist in that artifact's patch; client-supplied context is never trusted as evidence on its own.

side.description: Diff side associated with the patch anchor.

startLine.description: One-based source line where the text anchor begins.

endLine.description: One-based source line where the text anchor ends.

headSha.description: Head commit SHA associated with the patch anchor.

baseSha.description: Base commit SHA associated with the patch anchor.

CommentAnchor.description: The exact strict union and byte/range limits are shared with inputs.CommentAnchor.

cursor.description: CommentQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

rootId.description: Root comment whose replies to list; when present, the query returns that root's flat reply thread instead of the default page of root comments, and status filters no longer apply.

status.description: Filters root comments by resolution state ("open" or "resolved"); invalid together with rootId, since replies carry no resolution state of their own.

viewVersionId.description: Version being viewed, used to derive whether each returned comment's anchor still matches the current content or should be shown as outdated.

CommentQuery.description: Lists comment roots (or, with rootId, that root's flat replies) for an artifact version, using keyset pagination bound to the version, filters, and current principal.

cursor.description: MessageQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

MessageQuery.description: Lists a conversation's messages newest-first by immutable sequence for reverse-chronological loading; the UI reverses each loaded page for display.

cursor.description: ConversationTurnQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

ConversationTurnQuery.description: Lists a conversation's turns newest-first by the immutable triggering-message sequence, scoped to the route conversation and current principal.

ConversationTurnCancel.description: Cancels the conversation's active or queued coordinator turn; requires the turn's current If-Match. A queued turn is canceled immediately, while an active turn is marked cancel-requested and interrupts its session, remaining in the active slot until stopped or reconciled.

type.description: Discriminates a genuine Slack event delivery ("event_callback", which requires an `event_id` and a registered event schema) from Slack's one-time endpoint-verification handshake ("url_verification", answered only with its challenge).

event_id.description: Slack's delivery identifier for an `event_callback`; combined with the app registration to dedupe redelivered events by comparing payload digests.

api_app_id.description: Slack app ID the event was delivered to; confirms the event targets Bakery's configured Slack app before it is resolved to an organization connection.

team_id.description: Slack workspace ID the event originated from; resolved together with the channel to one authorized organization connection.

event.description: The nested Slack event object for an `event_callback` (for example, an app mention or message); validated against its registered event-type schema before normalization.

authorizations.description: Slack's list of installations authorized to receive this event. Bakery requires the entry for its own configured app and installation to be present and to match the verified team_id before the event is admitted; other entries are ignored.

items.description: SlackEvent.authorizations item JSON value.

challenge.description: Slack's echo value for a `url_verification` handshake; Bakery returns it verbatim as the entire response and never treats the request as ticket or chat work.

SlackEvent.description: Slack Events API payload delivered to Bakery's event webhook; verified by HMAC before parsing, then either answered with Slack's verification challenge or normalized into an authorized workspace/channel event.

items.description: JSON value node.
JSON value node.

team_id.description: Slack workspace (team) ID from the verified request; resolved together with the channel to the one authorized organization connection this command belongs to.

channel_id.description: Slack channel ID the command was invoked from; combined with the team ID to resolve the linked Bakery conversation through `channel_links`.

user_id.description: Slack user ID of the person who ran the command; must resolve to a currently linked, organization-scoped Bakery member before the command can carry privileged intent.

command.description: The invoked slash command's name (for example, `/bakery`), used to route the request to Bakery's command handler.

text.description: Free-text arguments typed after the slash command; parsed narrowly into one recognized instruction such as `plan`, `start`, `hold`, `resume`, `cancel`, or `answer <question-id> ...`.

api_app_id.description: Slack app ID the command was sent to; confirms the request targets Bakery's configured Slack app before it is resolved to a connection.

trigger_id.description: Slack's short-lived token for opening an interactive surface in response to this command. Bakery uses it only to open the confirmation or question modal for privileged commands within Slack's three-second window and does not persist it.

response_url.description: Slack-issued, expiring webhook URL for posting delayed responses to this command; a secret that must never be logged or exposed, and usable only a limited number of times within a short window.

SlackCommand.description: Slack slash-command payload delivered to Bakery's command webhook; verified by HMAC over the raw body before parsing, then resolved to one authorized workspace and channel connection before the command executes.

payload.description: Raw, form-encoded JSON string Slack sends describing the interaction; decoded and validated against the registered schema for its interaction type only after the raw body's HMAC is verified.

SlackInteraction.description: Slack interactive-component payload (for example, a button click or modal submission) delivered to Bakery's interactions webhook; verified by HMAC over the raw form body before the JSON `payload` field is parsed.

name.description: OrganizationCreate.name must contain at most 200 characters.

slug.description: OrganizationCreate.slug must contain at most 200 characters.

OrganizationCreate.description: Creates a new Bakery organization and the caller's initial Admin membership in one atomic operation; that Admin role carries no installation-administrator privilege.

registrationMode.description: Closed refuses new accounts; invitation requires a live organization invitation.

organizationCreationPolicy.description: Installation administrators only, or any authenticated human, may create organizations.

InstallationSettingsUpdate.description: Complete installation policy update by a live installation administrator; stale versions fail without writing.

principalId.description: Enabled human principal to grant installation authority; must differ from the live grantor.

InstallationAdministratorCreate.description: Grant installation administration to another enabled human; bootstrap grants are owner-only.

name.description: OrganizationUpdate.name must contain at most 200 characters.

logo.description: OrganizationUpdate.logo must contain at most 2000 characters.

metadata.description: OrganizationUpdate.metadata must contain at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

defaultLocale.description: OrganizationUpdate.defaultLocale may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: OrganizationUpdate.defaultLocale must contain at most 35 characters.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

OrganizationUpdate.description: Partial update to an organization's name, logo, metadata or default language; requires If-Match and at least one field. The organization's slug and other provider-owned identity fields cannot be changed here.

items.description: JSON value node.

principalId.description: Identifier of the principal being granted membership; must reference an enabled Bakery human, service, or worker principal.

anyOf.description: Organization role granted to the new member: admin, developer, viewer or guest. Null is valid only for a service or worker principal receiving grant-only access with no role-bearing membership.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

role.description: OrganizationMembershipCreate.role may be null in this transport value.

OrganizationMembershipCreate.description: Grants an existing principal membership in this organization; only a current organization Admin may call this, and the principal must already be an enabled Bakery human, service, or worker identity.

role.description: OrganizationMembershipUpdate.role may be null in this transport value.

anyOf.description: New organization role: admin, developer, viewer or guest. Setting it to null removes a service or worker's shared permission bundle, leaving grant-only access; it is never null for a human member.
Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

status.description: New membership status. Setting inactive immediately denies organization access even though the principal's other permission grants remain intact.

OrganizationMembershipUpdate.description: Partial update to an existing membership's role or status; requires If-Match and at least one field, and can never remove the organization's last active Admin.

email.description: OrganizationInvitationCreate.email must contain at most 320 characters.

role.description: Organization role requested for the invited human after Bakery-owned acceptance; it applies only to the selected organization.

OrganizationInvitationCreate.description: Admin request to create one Bakery-owned organization invitation; the selected organization and inviter authority come from the live action context, not this body.

id.description: Opaque Better Auth-compatible invitation UUID supplied in the query; it selects a candidate only and grants no organization access.

OrganizationInvitationRecipientGet.description: Authenticated recipient lookup input for the Better Auth-compatible get-invitation route; the server derives organization and recipient authority from the live invitation and identity.

invitationId.description: Opaque Better Auth-compatible invitation UUID supplied in the request body; it selects a candidate only and grants no organization access.

OrganizationInvitationRecipientAction.description: Authenticated recipient accept or reject input for the Better Auth-compatible invitation routes; the server derives organization and recipient authority from the live invitation and identity.

invitationId.description: Opaque invitation UUID from the invitation link path; it selects a live candidate only and grants no organization access.

OrganizationInvitationPreviewGet.description: Anonymous preview lookup input for the invitation landing route; the server derives every displayed value from the live invitation and accepts no organization header, email or selection.

provider.description: Integration provider to authorize against; only github is supported. The server builds the authorization URL from the provider app registered for this Bakery installation, never from request data.

reconnectConnectionId.description: When reconnecting an existing connection of the caller's organization, identifies it; completion for the same verified GitHub account refreshes that connection, and a different account creates a new pending connection and leaves this one unchanged. An unknown, archived or other organization's connection is refused as not found and no attempt is created.

returnPath.description: IntegrationAuthAttemptCreate.returnPath must contain at most 500 characters.

IntegrationAuthAttemptCreate.description: Starts a session-bound authorization attempt for connecting an organization to a provider; after checking Admin membership, the browser session and the registered provider app, the server returns a one-use authorization URL carrying a random state and an S256 PKCE challenge.

kind.description: Restricts results to one resource kind, such as repository, team, project, channel, or webhook_endpoint for a registered destination.

selected.description: Filters to resources that are, or are not, currently selected for use; an unselected resource is not actionable even if discovered.

available.description: Filters to resources the last complete discovery scan found still available; a resource only becomes unavailable after a complete successful scan, never a partial or throttled one.

cursor.description: IntegrationResourceQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

IntegrationResourceQuery.description: Filters the resources this connection has discovered, or when reused for destinations, its registered webhook endpoints, scoped to the current organization and connection.

selected.description: Adds or removes this resource from the connection's active selection; deselecting it blocks any grants that targeted it.

enabled.description: Dispatch switch for this resource of any kind: false keeps the resource selected and discoverable but stops effects and deliveries targeting it, without changing selection or discovery state.

displayName.description: IntegrationResourceUpdate.displayName must contain at most 200 characters.

IntegrationResourceUpdate.description: Selects or deselects, enables, or renames a discovered resource; at least one field is required, and the resource's external identity cannot change here.

IntegrationDiscoveryCreate.description: Triggers a bounded rediscovery scan of this connection's provider resources; only a complete, successful scan may mark previously seen resources unavailable, so a partial or throttled scan leaves the existing inventory untouched.

subjectType.description: Selects who receives the grant: a specific principal (subjectPrincipalId), every member holding an organization role (subjectRole) while a member, or a trusted automation (automationDefinitionId) rather than a human role.

subjectPrincipalId.description: The specific principal receiving this grant; required only when subjectType is principal.

subjectRole.description: Organization role receiving this grant, admin, developer, viewer or guest, so every current and future member holding that role while a member gets the fixed selection; required only when subjectType is organization_role.

automationDefinitionId.description: The trusted automation or workflow definition receiving this grant; required only when subjectType is automation, since automations need their own explicit grants separate from any human role.

direction.description: Which authority boundary this grant crosses: into_bakery for a scoped Bakery operation the connection may call (for example bakery:tasks:create), or out_of_bakery for an external provider action the connection may invoke (for example github.issue.comment.create@1).

capability.description: IntegrationGrantCreate.capability must contain at most 200 characters.

actionVersion.description: IntegrationGrantCreate.actionVersion must be at least 1.

resourceId.description: The selected integration resource, such as one repository, that the granted external action is scoped to; required alongside actionVersion for out-of-bakery grants.

applicationId.description: For into_bakery grants, the Bakery application the external subject may act on; at most one of applicationId or repositoryId is set and it must belong to the granting organization. Null for out_of_bakery grants, whose target is the connection and resource.

repositoryId.description: For into_bakery grants, the Bakery repository the external subject may act on; at most one of applicationId or repositoryId is set and it must belong to the granting organization. Null for out_of_bakery grants, whose target is the connection and resource.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry after which this grant stops being honored on every subsequent authorization check; omit for a grant that lasts until explicitly revoked.

IntegrationGrantCreate.description: Grants a specific integration capability, an inbound Bakery operation scope or an outbound external action, to exactly one subject (a principal, an organization role, or a trusted automation) on this connection; every target must belong to the current organization and connection, and there is no wildcard grant.

actionId.description: IntegrationActionInput.actionId must contain at most 200 characters.

actionVersion.description: IntegrationActionInput.actionVersion must be at least 1.

resourceId.description: Selected integration resource, such as one repository, that the action runs against; must be a resource the caller's grant actually covers.

arguments.description: IntegrationActionInput.arguments must contain at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

IntegrationActionInput.description: Body for invoking one registered action on this connection: which action, which pinned version, on which selected resource, with what arguments. Connection, organization and actor identity come from the route and trusted request context, never from this payload.

items.description: JSON value node.

resourceId.description: Restricts results to effects targeting one selected integration resource.

subscriptionId.description: Restricts results to effects that a specific event subscription produced.

status.description: Filters this connection's effects by lifecycle stage, prepared, submitted, confirmed, uncertain or failed, matching the ledger's effect state machine.

cursor.description: IntegrationEffectQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

IntegrationEffectQuery.description: Filters the external effects dispatched through this connection, scoped to resources the caller has read access to.

IntegrationReconciliationCreate.description: Requests a read-only recheck of an existing prepared or uncertain external effect against the provider's current state; it can confirm or leave the prior outcome unresolved, but it can never itself authorize a replacement write.

displayName.description: IntegrationDestinationCreate.displayName must contain at most 200 characters.

url.description: IntegrationDestinationCreate.url must contain at most 2000 characters.

secretId.description: References the stored secret used to sign outbound deliveries to this destination; kept separate from the destination's URL and never returned by the API.

enabled.description: Whether this destination starts out accepting deliveries; a subscription can be created before its destination is enabled, but a disabled destination blocks dispatch immediately.

IntegrationDestinationCreate.description: Registers a new outbound webhook endpoint resource that a subscription can later target; the URL and its DNS/redirect profile are reviewed and become immutable once created.

displayName.description: IntegrationDestinationUpdate.displayName must contain at most 200 characters.

enabled.description: Enables or disables this destination; disabling blocks unsent deliveries but does not affect effects already submitted.

archived.description: Marks the destination retired: subscriptions targeting it can no longer dispatch new deliveries.

IntegrationDestinationUpdate.description: Renames, enables/disables or archives an existing webhook destination; its URL and external identity cannot change here, since a new URL requires creating a new destination.

items.description: The integration resources, 1 to 100, whose events this subscription watches; the caller must have read access to each one. Each array item follows this format.
The event type names, 1 to 100, this subscription reacts to; only these types are delivered. Each array item follows this format.

eventTypes.description: IntegrationSubscriptionCreate.eventTypes must contain at most 100 items.

destinationResourceId.description: The registered destination, a webhook endpoint or a discovered chat channel/thread, that receives matching deliveries; must be an approved resource, never an arbitrary URL.

actionId.description: IntegrationSubscriptionCreate.actionId must contain at most 200 characters.

actionVersion.description: IntegrationSubscriptionCreate.actionVersion must be at least 1.

senderPrincipalId.description: The principal whose authority is checked when this subscription dispatches; activation rechecks that this sender still holds the exact destination action grant.

IntegrationSubscriptionCreate.description: Creates a disabled event subscription: which source resources and event types to watch, where to project matching events, and which destination and action delivers them. Activation is a separate step that rechecks source read access, the destination action grant, sender authority and provider permissions.

items.description: Replaces the set of source resources, 1 to 100, this subscription watches, when present; the caller must still have read access to every new resource. Each array item follows this format.

eventTypes.description: IntegrationSubscriptionUpdate.eventTypes must contain at most 100 items.

items.description: Replaces which event types, 1 to 100, this subscription reacts to, when present. Each array item follows this format.

destinationResourceId.description: Retargets this subscription to a different registered destination resource; the new destination's own action grant is rechecked before any delivery resumes.

actionId.description: IntegrationSubscriptionUpdate.actionId must contain at most 200 characters.

actionVersion.description: IntegrationSubscriptionUpdate.actionVersion must be at least 1.

senderPrincipalId.description: Changes which principal's authority is checked when this subscription dispatches; the new sender's destination action grant is rechecked before dispatch resumes.

enabled.description: Turns delivery on or off for this subscription; disabling blocks new deliveries while any already-submitted effect still resolves through reconciliation.

archived.description: Retires the subscription: no further deliveries are queued from it.

IntegrationSubscriptionUpdate.description: Edits an existing subscription's selection or lifecycle; at least one field is required. Any change increments the subscription's policy revision, discards deliveries queued under the old projection, and can never retarget effects already dispatched.

status.description: Filters deliveries by their effect lifecycle stage: prepared, submitted, confirmed, uncertain, or failed, the same states used for external effects generally.

cursor.description: IntegrationDeliveryQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

IntegrationDeliveryQuery.description: Filters the delivery receipts produced by one event subscription, scoped to resources the caller can read on both the source and destination side.

providerId.description: Identifies the integration provider whose account is being linked, for example Slack; the provider's OIDC/OAuth profile determines what verification is performed.

identityScope.description: ExternalIdentityLinkCreate.identityScope must contain at most 200 characters.

returnPath.description: ExternalIdentityLinkCreate.returnPath must contain at most 500 characters.

ExternalIdentityLinkCreate.description: Starts a Bakery-authenticated proof that the current member controls a specific external account (for example a Slack workspace user), so the host can bind that verified identity for later authority checks such as answering a question.

connectionId.description: Restricts results to ticket sources built on one integration connection; useful when a connection serves multiple repositories or sources.

enabled.description: Filters by whether the ticket source is currently enabled and actively syncing, versus disabled.

cursor.description: TicketSourceQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

TicketSourceQuery.description: Query parameters for listing this organization's configured ticket sources and their enabled state.

connectionId.description: Identifier of the integration connection (for example, the GitHub App installation's organization connection) this ticket source observes tickets through.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the discovered, selected integration resource (for example, the specific repository) this ticket source watches.

applicationId.description: Identifier of the registered Bakery application whose repository-role labels this ticket source's routing resolves against.

repositoryId.description: Identifier of a single fallback repository this ticket source targets when no repository-role label routing resolves a target.

externalContainerId.description: TicketSourceCreate.externalContainerId must contain at most 200 characters.

policy.description: TicketSourceCreate.policy must contain at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

TicketSourceCreate.description: Registers a new ticket source binding an integration connection's external container (for example, a GitHub repository) to Bakery, with a versioned, schema-validated automation policy.

items.description: JSON value node.

enabled.description: Enables or disables this ticket source; when disabled, Bakery stops observing and syncing its external container until it is re-enabled. Enabling a disabled source whose automatic admission is on restamps automatic.since to the server clock and advances the policy revision, so an issue labeled while the source was off waits for adoption. That re-enable also re-checks the delegation principal, so a request must replace a delegation whose principal has left the organization or it answers 422 delegation_principal_unknown.

policy.description: TicketSourceUpdate.policy must contain at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

TicketSourceUpdate.description: Partial update to an existing ticket source's enabled state or automation policy; requires at least one field and an `If-Match` against the source's current revision.

items.description: JSON value node.

filters.description: TicketPreviewCreate.filters must contain at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

TicketPreviewCreate.description: Requests a preview of which external tickets and repositories would match this ticket source's current policy; returns a durable operation and never admits or starts any matching ticket.

items.description: JSON value node.

TicketSyncCreate.description: Requests a bounded reconciliation scan of this ticket source against its external provider, for example to catch a missed webhook delivery; returns a durable operation rather than scanning inline.

sourceId.description: Restricts results to external tickets observed through one ticket source (for example, one connected GitHub repository); omitted, results span every ticket source visible to the caller.

state.description: Filters by the ticket's last-observed normalized state (for example, open or closed) as recorded in its cached snapshot, not a live re-check against the provider.

linked.description: Filters by whether the external ticket already has a `ticket_task_links` row connecting it to a Bakery task.

cursor.description: ExternalTicketQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

ExternalTicketQuery.description: Query parameters for listing this organization's cached external ticket snapshots; results reflect the last synchronized state, not a live provider fetch.

TicketReadinessCreate.description: Requests an assessment of whether this external ticket meets Bakery's readiness checks for planning or implementation; runs as a durable, budget-admitted operation.

taskId.description: Identifier of the Bakery task to link this external ticket to; must belong to the same organization as the ticket.

role.description: Whether this is the ticket's "primary" link, the one driving execution and progress comments with at most one nonterminal execution owner per ticket, or a "reference" link that provides context without owning execution.

TicketTaskLinkCreate.description: Attaches this external ticket to a Bakery task as a primary or reference link; linking alone never starts execution.

intent.description: Chooses the requested admission scope: "plan" authorizes research and a plan only and stops before implementation, while "start" authorizes the full research-plan-implement-deliver workflow.

requirementsDigest.description: TicketRequestCreate.requirementsDigest must contain at most 200 characters.

TicketRequestCreate.description: Requests Bakery to admit this external ticket for planning or implementation; current actor authority, source state, duplicate admission, readiness and budget are all checked atomically before one request generation is created.

title.description: RemoteTicketCreate.title must contain at most 200 characters.

body.description: RemoteTicketCreate.body must contain at most 20000 characters.

providerFields.description: RemoteTicketCreate.providerFields must contain at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

RemoteTicketCreate.description: Requests creation of a new ticket in the connected external tracker (GitHub first) through this ticket source's connection; the write goes through the external-effects ledger and remote identity is reconciled before any linked execution starts.

items.description: JSON value node.

visibility.description: Filters listed packages to private (published within the caller's organization) or public visibility; public projections never expose private organization state.

cursor.description: PluginPackageQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

PluginPackageQuery.description: Filter and pagination parameters for listing plugin packages visible to the caller; private packages are further restricted to callers with publisher-organization access.

name.description: PluginPackageCreate.name must contain at most 200 characters.

displayName.description: PluginPackageCreate.displayName must contain at most 200 characters.

license.description: PluginPackageCreate.license must contain at most 200 characters.

provenance.description: PluginPackageCreate.provenance must contain at most 16000 UTF-8 bytes.

PluginPackageCreate.description: Publishes a new private, unlisted plugin package identity under the caller's organization; public listing and marketplace distribution remain a later capability.

items.description: JSON value node.

versionName.description: PluginVersionCreate.versionName must contain at most 200 characters.

sdkRange.description: PluginVersionCreate.sdkRange must contain at most 200 characters.

manifest.description: PluginVersionCreate.manifest must contain at most 131072 UTF-8 bytes.

bundleObjectRef.description: PluginVersionCreate.bundleObjectRef must contain at most 2000 characters.

bundleDigest.description: PluginVersionCreate.bundleDigest must contain at most 64 characters.

sourceEvidence.description: PluginVersionCreate.sourceEvidence must contain at most 32000 UTF-8 bytes.

buildEvidence.description: PluginVersionCreate.buildEvidence must contain at most 32000 UTF-8 bytes.

PluginVersionCreate.description: Publishes a new immutable version of a plugin package from a validated bundle archive and file-digest manifest; the archive bytes are stored outside Postgres, and the version becomes selectable for installs only after validation passes.

items.description: JSON value node.
JSON value node.
JSON value node.

scope.description: Filters installs to organization-wide or personal scope; a personal install remains visible only to its owner or an authorized Admin regardless of this filter.

status.description: Filters installs by lifecycle status: staged pending activation, enabled, disabled, failed, or uninstalled.

cursor.description: PluginInstallQuery.cursor must contain at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

PluginInstallQuery.description: Filter and pagination parameters for listing plugin installs visible to the caller; personal installs are further restricted to their owner or an authorized Admin regardless of the filters applied.

packageId.description: Package being installed; the selected versionId must belong to this package.

WorkerHost.description: A registered worker machine's identity, derived operating state and declared capacity: OS/architecture, advertised capabilities and toolchain versions, concurrent execution slots, lifecycle status, and the server-derived desired mode, connectivity and readiness dimensions. desiredMode is Admin intent (accepting, paused, draining, revoked); connectivity derives only from authenticated heartbeat receipt times (stale after 30 seconds, offline after 60); readiness derives from current-generation checks, protocol compatibility, credential state and scheduling policy — never from a client-writable flag. Old inventory/check generations, unsafe secret isolation or offline capability cannot advertise usable capacity: readinessReason explains a needs_attention state. credentialGeneration increments on rotation or revocation, invalidating any bearer credential from an earlier generation; the credential itself is never returned in a response.

ReviewCycle.description: One immutable independent automated review of one exact candidate of a run: the head and base commits and the effective policy digest it judged, the reviewer's fresh server-created agent session and worker principal, and the implementing session and principal it reviewed. CheckRun.description: One immutable deterministic check outcome for a run: a fixed policy command run against the candidate head, or a commit, title, description or merge-message rule evaluated against trusted metadata. Each row binds the head, base, profile, effective policy, subject, checker, title, body, merge-message and commit-selection identities it was observed under, so a changed identity makes the affected row stale without re-running it. `result` is `passed` only for a verified process exit or a satisfied rule; `failed` means the check ran and did not pass; `unavailable` means no trustworthy observation exists (missing tool, checker or metadata, an unsupported checker, an unbound rule, an unavailable revision or a skipped check) and blocks a required check exactly like `failed`; `pending` and `canceled` never satisfy a required check. `reason` carries the machine code. Rows are never updated, so `updatedAt` equals `createdAt` and `version` is always 1.

RepositoryRulePreviewOrganization.description: The impact of a draft organization rules revision: the current and draft revisions, the draft digest publication would store, counts over every active repository, and a signed-cursor page of affected repositories ordered by repository id. Nothing is stored. One request scans at most 20,000 repositories and 12 MiB of summarized override data (counted in UTF-16 code units; UNPROCESSABLE too_many_repositories or preview_too_large). Each statement runs under a 5 second statement timeout and the whole scan is bounded by the 10 second request deadline (DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT). Admission is per server process: one scan per organization, one per principal and two per process; a refused request answers DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE with a retryAfterSeconds body field (there is no Retry-After header) and is retried by the caller.

repositoryId.description: Repository the bounded repair attempt runs against, using the same worktree and profile as the implement step it is fixing.

revision.description: RepairInput.revision must contain at most 40 characters.

fingerprint.description: Stable lowercase SHA-256 over the normalized path, category and title of the issue, with no line number; the worker computes it so a repeated fingerprint across repair cycles is deduplicated and recognized as an unchanged blocker.

severity.description: How serious the finding is; blocker and major block delivery, minor and note are advisory.

blocking.description: Whether this finding must be resolved before delivery can proceed; true exactly when severity is blocker or major, and the server rejects a report where the two disagree.

path.description: Finding.path must contain at most 200 characters.

anyOf.description: Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

line.description: Finding.line may be null in this transport value.

detail.description: Finding.detail must contain at most 500 characters.

items.description: Blocking findings from the latest independent review of this candidate that the repair must address, at most 25 and ordered blocker first; empty when only failed checks drive the repair. Each array item follows this format.

findings.description: RepairInput.findings must contain at most 25 items.

checkRunId.description: Identifier of the immutable check run row that recorded the failed observation; the repair evidence is this row, not the output text.

checkId.description: FailedCheck.checkId must contain at most 100 characters.

result.description: Observed outcome of the check; never passed, because a passing check is not a failed check.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the result, such as exit_nonzero, deadline or tool_missing; verified is excluded because it explains only a pass.

anyOf.description: Null indicates that the value is unavailable.

exitCode.description: FailedCheck.exitCode may be null in this transport value.

items.description: Required checks that did not pass on this candidate, with the check run id, check id, result, reason and exit code of each; empty when only blocking findings drive the repair. Each array item follows this format.

failedChecks.description: RepairInput.failedChecks must contain at most 32 items.

reviewId.description: Identifier the reviewer generated for this review; it becomes the id of the recorded review cycle and must never repeat.

sessionId.description: Agent session the reviewer ran in. The server created it when it admitted the review step and requires the report to name exactly that session, so a review cannot claim another session's identity.

headSha.description: Full commit SHA the reviewer judged; the server requires it to equal the revision admitted for the job and the run's current candidate. ReviewOutput.headSha must contain at least 1 characters.

baseSha.description: Base commit SHA pinned by the inspected repository profile; the server requires it to equal its own pin. ReviewOutput.baseSha must contain at least 1 characters.

policyDigest.description: Digest of the effective policy the review ran under; the server recomputes it from its pins and rejects a mismatch. ReviewOutput.policyDigest must contain at least 1 characters.

fingerprint.description: Stable lowercase SHA-256 over the normalized path, category and title of the issue, with no line number; the worker computes it so a repeated fingerprint across repair cycles is deduplicated and recognized as an unchanged blocker.

severity.description: How serious the finding is; blocker and major block delivery, minor and note are advisory.

blocking.description: Whether this finding must be resolved before delivery can proceed; true exactly when severity is blocker or major, and the server rejects a report where the two disagree.

path.description: Finding.path must contain at most 200 characters.

findings.description: Structured findings in severity order, blocker first, each with a stable fingerprint; fingerprints are unique within the report. The server rejects a report whose blocking flags disagree with severities, or whose serialized size exceeds the review result byte budget. ReviewOutput.findings must contain at most 25 items.

blockingFindings.description: Count of findings with severity blocker or major. The server recomputes it from the findings and rejects a report that disagrees, so the worker's count never establishes an approval. ReviewOutput.blockingFindings must be at most 25.
